limitations.text: Resource items B-D are taken as reported (0.00); no independent source exists.
The D+1 comparison is not performed (synthetic convention).
PDF key details are parsed from a fixed synthetic layout; no human confirmation of extracted fields.
Results show the internal consistency of illustrative synthetic data, not operational truth or compliance.
Monthly totals are not included: the engine does not calculate them and the pack performs no financial calculation (D4).
EXC-SC3B-01 has no eligible AI investigation; it is reported from the deterministic results only.
AI investigations examine one exception at a time; there is no group-level AI investigation.
Supporting PDF documents (IN-15..IN-19) are not used as AI evidence.
Reported values are copied from the deterministic engine and source records; this report recalculates nothing.

AI requests use the OpenAI Responses API with store=False (no application-state storage). OpenAI's default abuse-monitoring retention still applies unless the organisation has approved Zero Data Retention or Modified Abuse Monitoring; this has not been established for this project.
